topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: Reflecting on the serendipity of the universe, I find myself standing at the school gates, an old familiar face greeting me — the teacher from my own past now shaping the chapters of my child’s story. The world, it seems, has a delightful way of weaving threads through time and space, connecting generations in unexpected ways. As I watch my child, now eager to learn and explore, I am struck by the depth of this moment. This teacher, who once guided me through the early terrains of knowledge and curiosity, now holds the hands of the next generation, passing on wisdom with the same gentle care and boundless enthusiasm. A seamless continuation, a perfect circle of mentorship and growth.
